translations.web: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
translations.bsb: And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
translations.kjv: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
